capabilities: scan the vault for unused block IDs
list the block IDs found unused
remove unused block IDs after confirmation
extras: README warns to back up the vault before use to avoid data loss, and documents limitations: block IDs referenced only in canvas cards are treated as unused, and duplicate block IDs on one page cannot be resolved.
problem: Obsidian keeps block IDs in files even after the references to them are gone, leaving clutter that users must clean up manually.
summary: Maintenance plugin that scans the vault for block IDs no note references and removes them from the Markdown files.
